verification: Exact public raw-results copy matched the recovered compute result byte-for-byte. Population, endpoints, array count, whole/payload histogram counts, weighted sums, ranges, elapsed limit, final roundtrip, source/script hashes, binary hash, scheduler terminal state and exit codes passed.
limitations: The census is exhaustive for the 2^20 low-bit values zero-left-padded to ten bytes, not for all 2^80 ten-byte inputs.
The timed region excludes node, scheduler and process startup, but includes independent libbzip2 stream initialization and allocation.
Payload excludes only outer BZh1 framing, end marker, combined CRC and pad bits; internal block headers, CRC, tables and controls remain.
Only the last timed stream was decompressed after timing; every histogram count and aggregate was validated independently from the result records.
